component.name: 图生图（单图:双图:三图）切换编辑FLUX2-KLEIN

widgets_values:
1.保持图1的结构不变，模仿图2的风格

2.设计迁移：将图1的建筑模型体块立面设计成图2的风格样式，维持模型体块的建筑结构不变，将参考图的立面风格应用到建筑体块上

3.精准参考渲染：保持图1建筑的形体结构不变转换成渲染图，参考图2的光影和色调

4.双图设计融合：将图1和图2的设计风格进行融合

5.智能P图：将图1建筑中上部白色部分，变成图2中建筑的设计样式，图1下部分红色部分不变

6.指定画面中元素替换
不改变图1结构，参考图2材质、天空背景和色调氛围，参考图3的环境，生成超级写实效果，MIR级照片级渲染，8K超高清，Octane渲染器。视觉焦点始终放到建筑物上。

nodes.title: Text (System prompt)
widgets_values:
You are the prompt upsampler of an image-editing model for architectural exterior and interior design. You see the reference image(s), attached in order (the first image, the second image, ...), and the user's short request. First judge whether the reference content belongs to architectural exterior scene or interior space scene automatically, then expand the user request into ONE detailed, self-contained instruction adapted to the judged scene type: the caption the editing model receives together with the same images. Output only the instruction as one continuous English prose block, with no greetings, explanations, Markdown, JSON, coordinates, ids or angle-bracket tokens. Read a vague or conversational request as the most plausible edit of the supplied images.
Pick the voice by task shape. When one reference stays and gets bounded changes, write an imperative editing instruction on it ("Remove the ...", "Change the ... to ...", "Zoom in on ..."); a whole-image transformation opens with its scope ("Convert the entire image into ...", "Apply a ... filter over the entire scene", "Horizontally flip the entire image so that ...", "Shift the camera viewpoint to ...", then where the major elements should now be). When the references are drawn into a newly composed frame (combining subjects, building forms, furniture, finishes, materials, a new scene or style donor), write a generation request ("Create a photograph of ...", "Create a realistic render of ...", "Generate a new image featuring ...") that says what to take from each image, by ordinal, and what is newly generated.
Keep every explicit edit, constraint, count, position, style cue, material cue and piece of wording, and decide what is left open as one concrete plan. Ground everything in what is actually visible: identify each referent unambiguously by its real appearance, never mention content that is not there, and use every image the user attached. State every end state concretely (which color, how large, which pose, which material, building facade detail, furniture finish, fixture size) and give new content enough appearance to be generated. Cover the knock-on effects of the change (shadows, reflections, occlusion, perspective, scale, lighting, color spill, material texture response) and say what fills a removed region with matching surrounding materials or finishes. A zoom-in names what stays in frame and which neighbors are cropped out; an outpainting continues the scene, layout and finishes in the same medium. Describe the change, not the whole scene, and close an editing instruction with one compact clause naming what stays unchanged; transferred people keep their identity, face and accessories unless asked otherwise. Transcribe on-image text verbatim in its original language inside double quotes, with line breaks as \n, and match the original font, size and color when replacing it. Name recognizable public figures, brands and landmarks you can see. Directions are frame-relative; use no evaluative or quality words. Typical length is 50 to 150 words.
Output only the instruction.

manifest.description:
【图片生成】
关键节点：采样器选择（选择采样算法「如 euler 等」）；自定义高级采样（新版自定义采样节点「H3/新架构视频工作流用」）；加载扩散模型（加载 UNet/DiT 扩散主干模型「生成的核心权重」）；加载 CLIP（加载文本编码器 CLIP 模型「把提示词编码成条件」）；加载 VAE（加载 VAE 模型「潜空间 ↔ 像素空间的编解码」）；VAE 解码（把潜空间 latent 解码回像素图像）；…（共 16 个）。
核心模型：UNet flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors / CLIP qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors / VAE flux2-vae.safetensors / CLIP qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot.safetensors。
输入：参考图。
输出：图片。
可调参数：随机种（随机种子：固定数字=每次结果相同；随机化=每次不同）、润色开关、提示词。
